sentence: This project uses DNA to record how molecules are arranged in whole tissue and tests how a cell's family history shapes the tissue's form.
This project builds a tool that uses a laser to image and control the electronic states of quantum materials.
This project builds robot hands, dexterous skills and simple controls so that robots can be useful right out of the box.
This project designs a robot that can walk, fly, jump and run to move through very tight crawlspaces.
This project builds statistical methods that summarize large collections of documents and compare text written by people with text written by AI.
This project carries out cybersecurity research on problems such as memory forensics, reverse engineering, malware analysis and network security.
This project builds a method that mixes imperfect AI predictions with human feedback to make precise measurements from satellite imagery, radar, acoustics and sonar.
This project builds tools to find why the Domain Name System fails and to uncover bugs in it, including in Internet of Things devices.
This project builds a way for an underwater robot to estimate the water flow around it so it can work out its own position.
This project builds computer vision methods that study human physical skills in large collections of images and videos so robots can learn them.
This project builds a faster campus research network that moves large data quickly between researchers, scientific instruments and computing clusters.
This project uses mass spectrometry to find out how solvent molecules link into large molecules at the boundary between battery electrodes and electrolyte.
This project studies how often biology courses link science to real-world social problems and whether doing so helps learning and the wish to stay in science.
This project studies how hard it is for computers to work out properties of quantum systems, such as the energy of a system.
This project builds tiny circuits on a single chip that join semiconductor lasers with lithium niobate to make and control light.
This project studies how iron nanoparticles that enter cyanobacterial cells cause oxidative stress and change the cell's pigments, proteins and lipids.
This project builds a hydrologic model of surface water and groundwater, using satellite and GPS data, to find out how groundwater affects lake levels.
This project builds tools that find which proteins interact with each other inside specific compartments of plant cells.
